formDescription: Complete this form to determine your federal income tax withholding for employment in 2026.

labels: City or Town, State, and ZIP Code

textboxes.label: City or Town, State, and ZIP Code

autopopulate.profileDescription: City or Town, State, and ZIP Code

questions.text: What is your address?
questions.explanation: Enter your home street address or P.O. Box as the applicant. This is your personal residence — not the agency or employer address.

questions.text: What is your social security number?
questions.explanation: Enter your social security number exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your filing status?
questions.explanation: Select the option or options that best apply to your situation.

options.label: Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse
options.value: Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse

questions.text: Please confirm: Multiple jobs or spouse works
questions.explanation: Select this option if you have more than one job at the same time or if you are married filing jointly and your spouse also works.

questions.text: How much do you claim for qualifying children?
questions.explanation: Enter your qualifying children amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: How much do you claim for other dependents?
questions.explanation: Enter your other dependents amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your total for all credits?
questions.explanation: Enter your total credits amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: Do you have other income you want tax withheld for?
questions.explanation: Answer Yes if you expect to receive income such as interest, dividends, or retirement income that will not have tax withheld. This is not from jobs.

questions.text: What is your other income amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your other income amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: Do you want to claim deductions other than the standard deduction?
questions.explanation: Answer Yes if you plan to claim itemized deductions or other deductions that reduce your withholding.

questions.text: What is your deductions amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your deductions amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: Do you want extra tax withheld from each paycheck?
questions.explanation: Answer Yes if you want your employer to withhold an additional amount of tax from each pay period.

questions.text: What is your extra withholding amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your extra withholding amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: Please confirm: Exempt from withholding
questions.explanation: Check this box only if you meet both conditions for exemption from withholding for 2026 as described in the instructions.

questions.text: What is your employer's name and address?
questions.explanation: This asks for your employer's street address or P.O. Box — not your personal home address unless you live at your workplace. See the Employer section on the PDF.

questions.text: What is your first date of employment?
questions.explanation: Enter your first date of employment exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your employer's identification number?
questions.explanation: Enter the employer identification number (EIN) for the business entity, if applicable.

questions.text: What is the Multiple Jobs Worksheet Line 1 amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your multiple jobs worksheet line 1 amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is the Multiple Jobs Worksheet Line 2a amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your multiple jobs worksheet line 2a amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is the Multiple Jobs Worksheet Line 2b amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your multiple jobs worksheet line 2b amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is the Multiple Jobs Worksheet Line 2c amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your multiple jobs worksheet line 2c amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: How many pay periods per year for the highest paying job?
questions.explanation: Enter your pay periods per year exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is the Multiple Jobs Worksheet Line 4 amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your multiple jobs worksheet line 4 amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your qualified tips amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your qualified tips amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your qualified overtime compensation amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your qualified overtime compensation amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your qualified passenger vehicle loan interest amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your qualified passenger vehicle loan interest amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.
questions.placeholder: Qualified Passenger Vehicle Loan Interest Amount

questions.text: What is your Deductions Worksheet Line 2 total?
questions.explanation: Enter your deductions worksheet line 2 total exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your senior amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your senior self amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your senior spouse amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your senior spouse amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your senior total amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your senior total amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your other adjustments amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your other adjustments amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What are your medical and dental expenses?
questions.explanation: Enter your medical and dental expenses amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What are your state and local taxes?
questions.explanation: Enter the state and ZIP for your home address as the applicant.

questions.text: What is your home mortgage interest amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your home mortgage interest amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What are your charitable gifts?
questions.explanation: Enter your charitable gifts amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What are your other itemized deductions?
questions.explanation: Enter your other itemized deductions amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your itemized deductions total?
questions.explanation: Enter your itemized deductions total exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your total income amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your total income amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your income minus senior total?
questions.explanation: Enter your income minus senior total exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your itemized deductions limit?
questions.explanation: Enter your itemized deductions limit exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What are your adjusted itemized deductions?
questions.explanation: Enter your adjusted itemized deductions exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your standard deduction amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your standard deduction amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What are your cash gifts to charities?
questions.explanation: Enter your cash gifts to charities amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your standard deduction plus cash gifts?
questions.explanation: Enter your standard deduction plus cash gifts exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your Deductions Worksheet Line 14 amount?
questions.explanation: Enter your deductions worksheet line 14 amount exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your Deductions Worksheet total?
questions.explanation: Enter your deductions worksheet total exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your first name?
questions.explanation: Enter your first name and middle initial exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.

questions.text: What is your middle initial?
questions.explanation: Enter your middle initial if you have one; it will be combined with your first name on the PDF.

questions.text: What is your last name?
questions.explanation: Enter your last name exactly as it should appear on the completed form in the Applicant Information section.
